entry.title: Bound states in the continuum through quantum interference in ultracold atomic collisions
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03519-6 Resonances in ultracold collisions couple to scattering states, causing interactions and loss. Now it is shown that the interference of Feshbach resonances creates a bound state in the continuum that decouples from elastic and inelastic scattering.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Active-flow-driven DNA remodelling generates millimetre-scale mechanical oscillations
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03505-y Active matter can exhibit turbulent or coherent flows. Now it is shown that active flows can entangle DNA polymers, leading to a non-equilibrium transition from disordered turbulence to periodic motion.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Coherence enhancement through equilibration to near-zero optical temperatures
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03520-z Phase-space conservation bars coherence enhancement in passive linear optics, a limit often bypassed by gain or feedback. Here conservative nonlinearity reshapes phase space, thermodynamically driving incoherent light towards a coherent equilibrium.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: The challenge of recognition in large scientific collaborations
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03511-0 The authorship practices of large collaborations can hide individual contributions. A recognition programme developed by the LIGO Scientific Collaboration publicly documents verified contributions to research, infrastructure and community service.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics
